_meta.purpose: One-off manual corrections to specific SKUs' CM1/CM2/CM3 € figures. Applied AFTER aggregate_periods, NOT written back to the Novadata exports. Each entry is pro-rated over the days of overlap between its date range and the user's current selection.
_meta.schema: adjustments[SKU] = [ { from, to, deltas: {CM1, CM2, CM3}, note, applied_at, applied_by } ]

VV-VITA-266.note: Return-spike normalisation: May 2026 absorbed 4,068 unit returns and €91,873 in refunded product sales — vs a 1.7-2.2% baseline return rate in Mar/Apr. The spike is a catch-up of returns from earlier periods, not a Mar-May economic event, so the abnormal portion is added back to CM1/CM2/CM3. Adjusted CM3 ≈ +€27,000 (+45%), consistent with healthy Vegavero SKUs. NOT written back to the source data.
